parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: Performs a dry run without calling the operation. The system checks the request parameters, request format, business limits, and resources. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false (default): Sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run
